 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No./Crime No. 310/2022 registered at Police Station Gurh, District Rewa (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376, 506 of the IPC and under Section and later on Sections 376(2)(n) and 306 of IPC were added in the charge sheet.

The allegation against the present applicant is that he has committed rape of the prosecutrix and threatened her that if she did not comply with his demands he will disseminate the information regarding the incident and make it viral on Facebook due to the aforesaid threat the prosecutrix poured kerosene and set herself on fire in the washroom of their house.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that from the photos and videos of the deceased prosecutrix and the applicant it is clear that they shared a consensual relationship.

It is further submitted that there is no whisper of any allegation of rape in the first dying declaration dated 08.10.2022 and only after three dated i.e. 11.10.2022 that the deceased prosecutrix alleged the commission of rape in her statement and since the only evidence against the applicant is the dying declaration which are not reliable, there is no prima facie case against the applicant.
Further, it is submitted that applicant has no criminal antecedent and he is in custody since 11.10.2022.
Charge-sheet has been filed and conclusion of trial will take sufficient time.
On the aforesaid grounds, prayer is made to release the applicant on bail.
Learned Panel lawyer has opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, on a perusal of the material available on record including the case diary, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicants/accused shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump, breach of any of the pre-condition of bail and in case of repetition, this order s hal l become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR (VERMA)) JUDGE DevS Ramkrishna @ Chotu Chaurasiya vs State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84331036/
